conclusion.archiverCounterInterpretation: CNPG v1.30.1 returns nil after a Debug-level no-backup skip from wal-archive. pg_stat_archiver counts and ContinuousArchiving=True do not demonstrate an upload.
conclusion.classification: CNPG restore helper configured with no CNPG archive source; no evidence of an object-storage fetch or fetch failure.
conclusion.commandCaveat: The captured runtime SQL deliberately redacted the full command string; its safe classifier recorded executable/subcommand and no cloud keywords. The displayed full argv is the source-derived CNPG v1.30.1 template, with `%f` and `%p` placeholders preserved; it was not executed.
conclusion.confidence: High that CNPG Barman restore could not fetch object storage: no backup/external source/plugin is configured, and the observed future-history-file rejection is before archive lookup. Captured logs alone cannot rule out unrelated non-CNPG processes, but none are configured/referenced by the workload.
conclusion.futureTimelineHistoryEvent: CNPG v1.30.1 validates replica history-file timeline before archive lookup; file timeline 3 > cluster timeline 2 returns ErrWALNotFound.
conclusion.reason: The active Cluster has no backup BarmanObjectStore, no externalClusters, and no plugins. In CNPG v1.30.1 the regular replica restore path returns ErrNoBackupConfigured and skips WAL restore before creating a Barman restorer. Manager log level is info, so Trace/Debug skip messages are suppressed.
